import re

def main():
    s = input()
    count = 0
    if s:
        pattern = re.compile(r"(?<=(.))(?!\1)", re.DOTALL)
        runs = pattern.split(s)
        for run in runs:
            if len(run) % 2 == 0:
                count += 1
    print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
